# dbaas_recovery_points (Data Source)

Read available snapshot recovery points without creating or restoring a database. Only engines whose catalog restore_modes include snapshot have recovery points; reading any other engine fails.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `instance_id` (String) Authorized source instance ID, including a deleted source with retained recovery.
- `zone` (String) Exact configured DBaaS zone name or UUID. Use the computed UUID for subsequent operations.

### Read-Only

- `recovery_points` (Attributes List) Available snapshot recovery points, ordered by opaque ID. Other restore modes remain catalog capabilities. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--recovery_points))
- `zone_id` (String) Resolved routing zone UUID.

<a id="nestedatt--recovery_points"></a>
### Nested Schema for `recovery_points`

Read-Only:

- `completed_at` (String) Snapshot completion time.
- `created_at` (String) Snapshot creation time.
- `id` (String) Opaque recovery-point ID.
